name: Noospheric Recon
summary: Pteraxii, Infiltrators, Rangers, Serberys Raiders and Serberys Sulphurhounds units gain Recon Augury. In your Shooting phase, a Recon Augury unit can mark a visible enemy unit within 12" as analysed, giving it +3" detection range.

name: Cyber-Psalm Programming
summary: Legio Cybernetica units get +2" Move, and +1 Objective Control while not Battle-shocked.

name: Benedictions Of The Omnissiah
summary: At the first battle round, pick a Benediction for Cult Mechanicus units until the battle ends: Panegyric Procession adds 1 AP to ranged attacks at half range; Citation in Savagery adds 1 Strength and Attacks to melee weapons after a Charge.

name: Murderous Imperative
summary: Skitarii attacks re-roll a Hit roll of 1 while Protector Imperative is active, or a Wound roll of 1 while Conqueror Imperative is active.

name: Acquisition At Any Cost
summary: Each Command phase, mark one objective marker as your Acquisition marker until your next Command phase. Adeptus Mechanicus attacks made within range of it, or against a target within range of it, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

name: Noospheric Transference
summary: Each Command phase, grant the HALO OVERRIDE keyword to 1-3 Adeptus Mechanicus units (by battle size) until your next Command phase, then pick one Override for them: +2" Move, +1 Toughness, can charge after Advancing, or Stealth.

name: War-Form Mantles
summary: Tech-Priest models get a 4+ invulnerable save and Feel No Pain 5+. Unshocked, when selected to shoot they roll a D6; on 2+ either force a battle-shock roll at -1 on an enemy Vehicle within 12", once per turn, or stay Hidden after shooting.

name: Rad-bombardment
summary: Round 1: enemy units in the opponent's deployment zone that stand firm take D3 mortal wounds on 3+; ones taking cover are battle-shocked and take D3 on 5+. Rounds 2-5: each such unit rolls 3+ to take 1 mortal wound and a Battle-shock test.

name: Stealth Optimisation
summary: Skitarii Infantry, Skitarii Mounted and Ironstrider Ballistarii units gain the Stealth ability.
